<!-- Release: v0.5.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Configurable navigation tabs with dedicated search views
- Expanding mini-player with swipe controls and a queue overlay
- Restored browsing history and configurable Back behavior

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/14 - Configurable navigation and an expanding player

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.5.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Open Localica and choose your music folder in Settings.
